issues.title: [INKWAVE][P0][Flingza] Vertical paint-only side droplets retain player damage
issues.body:
## Code-confirmed mismatch
Splatoon 3 11.3.0 `WeaponRollerVariable` (Flingza/ヴァリアブル) vertical `VerticalSwingUnitGroupParam.Unit[3]` and `Unit[4]` each emit **6 droplets** with **`PaintOnly: true`**, centered at `SpawnRotateYDegree: +18° / -18°`. The Japanese parameter wiki explicitly defines `PaintOnly` as **do not produce damage** (ヴァリ横飛沫専用).
Current catalog `mode(...,'vertical')` attaches the common damaging `VerticalSwingUnitGroupParam.DamageParam` to EVERY unit's descriptor, while `emitUnits` spawns all 6+6 droplets and `impactDamage` never checks `u.PaintOnly` (the field does not appear anywhere in `main-weapon-catalog.mjs`). Even a zero nominal player radius does not guarantee the central projectile misses an overlapping hurtbox.

## Required fix/verification
- Keep 12 paint-only side droplets as turf-producing particles, but explicitly prohibit direct player, special-object and boss damage from those droplets.
- Validate that unit 3/4 paint-only descendants can hit terrain, including steep vertical camera pitch, yet report 0 damage against a central swept capsule and side colliders.
- Retain central 5 damaging vertical projectiles, wall interactions, turf ownership, 30/60/120Hz and network replay.
- Separate `SpawnRotateYDegree=±18°` orientation gap is filed independently.

Sources: [Pinned 11.3.0 Flingza record](https://github.com/Leanny/splat3/blob/7280ff9cde8bb1c5dcef46c700c326471584d2e6/data/parameter/1130/weapon/WeaponRollerVariable.game__GameParameterTable.json) · [main catalog runtime](https://github.com/rhgrive3/actions/blob/144923aefc282a588225ac44de3da95762653add/patches/splatoon3/runtime/main-weapon-catalog.mjs) · [S3 parameter interpretation](https://wikiwiki.jp/splatoon3mix/検証/パラメータ情報). 
Confidence: **confirmed source-field omission and wrong damage-admission path**; actual retail damage endpoint not measured.

issues.title: [INKWAVE][Roller] Catalog vertical flick ignores per-glob elevation offsets and yaw baselines
issues.body:
## Affected added weapons
Carbon Roller, Dynamo Roller, Flingza Roller, Big Swig Roller (4 catalog weapons; legacy Splat Roller uses another implementation).

Their pinned 11.3.0 `VerticalSwingUnitGroupParam.Unit` data contain `SpawnRotateXDegreeBase` and `AfterOffsetSpawnRotateXDegree=-2.5°` for multiple projectile units. E.g. Carbon vertical unit 1 has `BulletNum=2`, `SpawnRotateXDegreeBase=5°`, `AfterOffsetSpawnRotateXDegree=-2.5°`: expected base elevation 5°, then 2.5° (subject to native angle convention). Unit 2 likewise has index-dependent -2.5°.
Flingza additional paint-only units 3/4 have **`SpawnRotateYDegree=+18°/-18°`**.
Current `emitUnits` uses `SpawnRotateXDegree` or `SpawnRotateXDegreeBase` once per group, never reads `AfterOffsetSpawnRotateXDegree`, and only reads `BaseRotateYDegree`, never `SpawnRotateYDegree`. This collapses source-distinct vertical arcs and Flingza lateral side splashes.

## Tests required
Check per-index actual 60Hz emitted pitches and yaw for all 4 rollers on neutral/±45° camera pitch. Preserve source speeds, splash counts and `PaintOnly` collision admission; ensure both local and ghost/replay velocities match source per-unit offsets.

Sources: [S3 roller parameter documentation](https://wikiwiki.jp/splatoon3mix/検証/パラメータ情報) · [source records](https://github.com/Leanny/splat3/tree/7280ff9cde8bb1c5dcef46c700c326471584d2e6/data/parameter/1130/weapon) · [catalog emission](https://github.com/rhgrive3/actions/blob/144923aefc282a588225ac44de3da95762653add/patches/splatoon3/runtime/main-weapon-catalog.mjs).
Confidence: **confirmed field omission**; exact angle-to-distance retail comparison remains separate.

issues.title: [INKWAVE][Roller/Brush] Source late-flight damage reduction is absent on 7 added weapons
issues.body:
## Confirmed code-level omission
All **4 added Roller** and **3 Brush** weapons have nonzero `DamageRejectStartFrame`, `DamageRejectEndFrame` and `DamageRejectRate=0.5` in the 11.3.0 `VerticalSwingUnitGroupParam/WideSwingUnitGroupParam/SwingUnitGroupParam.DamageParam`.
Examples: Carbon vertical 30→45F, Dynamo/Flingza/Big Swig vertical 40→65F, Inkbrush 20→40F, Octobrush/Painbrush 24→45F. Horizontal rollers have independent thresholds too.

The shipped catalog `impactDamage` only applies distance bands and `ReduceStartFrame`/fall-distance fields, never reads any `DamageReject*`. Delayed/long-airtime projectiles retain excessive distance-band damage. These properties were previously corrected for the legacy Splat Roller in closed #124 and #128, but the **catalog interpreter** is a different owner and does not inherit those fixes.

## Acceptance
Unit-realistic damage before/start/mid/end of each extracted time interval, in horizontal and vertical flicks; compose with inside/outside angle profiles and `PaintOnly` filtering, object/boss damage and ghost replay. Do not add an unrelated age-only multiplier to Sloshers/Shooters.

Refs: [catalog impactDamage](https://github.com/rhgrive3/actions/blob/144923aefc282a588225ac44de3da95762653add/patches/splatoon3/runtime/main-weapon-catalog.mjs#L980) · [S3 parameter documentation](https://wikiwiki.jp/splatoon3mix/検証/パラメータ情報) · historical #124/#128.
Confidence: **confirmed omitted sourced time multipliers**.

issues.title: [INKWAVE][Roller/Brush] Added seven weapons reject low-ink source depletion flicks
issues.body:
## Confirmed difference
All 4 catalog Rollers (Carbon, Dynamo, Flingza, Big Swig) and all 3 Brushes (Inkbrush, Octobrush, Painbrush) have extracted 11.3.0 low-ink projectile data: `DepletionBulletNum`, `DepletionSpeedRate`, many `CollisionParam.DepletionRate` and `PaintParam.DepletionDepthWidthRate`.
Examples: Carbon horizontal `BulletNum=10`, `DepletionBulletNum=3`, `DepletionSpeedRate=.5`; Octobrush first group `BulletNum=3`, depleted `1`, speed ×.5; Roller vertical affected groups have speed ×.7.
Current catalog `swing()` calls `pay(runner, full InkConsume)` and `pay()` **rejects the press** when ink is below that cost; `emitUnits()` always emits `BulletNum` at full speed, with no `DepletionBulletNum/DepletionSpeedRate` branch (these strings never appear in the catalog runtime).
Closed #305 fixed the separate legacy Splat Roller owner, not this catalog interpreter.

## Verification and acceptance
Real Actor input at ink just below normal per-flick cost, low and zero; verify source depletion pellet count, speed, damage and field/player collision/paint; no free ink generation, no remote packet duplication, 30/60/120Hz parity. Preserve the completed legacy #305 behavior.

Links: [main catalog](https://github.com/rhgrive3/actions/blob/144923aefc282a588225ac44de3da95762653add/patches/splatoon3/runtime/main-weapon-catalog.mjs#L405) · [pinned tables](https://github.com/Leanny/splat3/tree/7280ff9cde8bb1c5dcef46c700c326471584d2e6/data/parameter/1130/weapon) · [parameter semantics](https://wikiwiki.jp/splatoon3mix/検証/パラメータ情報) · old #305.
**Confidence: high, missing explicit sourced alternate launch path.**

issues.title: [INKWAVE][Brush] Pablo/Octobrush/Painbrush ignore swing-direction yaw and source nearest splash
issues.body:
## Source/implementation mismatch
3 Brush mains: Inkbrush (パブロ), Octobrush (ホクサイ), Painbrush (フィンセント).
Their `SwingUnitGroupParam.Unit` records contain separate `SpawnRotateYDegreeLeftToRight` and `SpawnRotateYDegreeRightToLeft`; Inkbrush group0 uses **-10° vs +10°**, Painbrush group1 **-3° vs +3°**. The Japanese source parameter guide expressly identifies these as separate base yaw offsets for opposite swing directions.
Catalog `emitUnits(key='brush')` only uses `BaseRotateYDegree + SpawnWideDegree` and **never reads either swing-direction source field**. Thus alternating brush flicks have the same base projectile fan, despite the sourced side-specific headings.
Each Brush's `SwingUnitGroupParam.SplashNearestParam` also contains explicit near-foot paint timing/width: Inkbrush `LoopNum=6,OrderNum=2,PaintWidthHalf=1.5`; Octobrush width 2; Painbrush `LoopNum=4,OrderNum=2,PaintWidthHalf=2.3`. Added catalog `emitUnits` calls `paintCatalogRollerNearest` for *roller only* and never implements Brush `SplashNearestParam`. Running brush-stroke ground paint is a separate owner and does not recreate these exact swing release slots.

## Acceptance
Test alternating swing directions with actual Actor release and gun yaw, source absolute/deviation yaw; source near-paint slot count for 6/4 swing sequences at varied aim/pitch, obstacles, ink status, and no remote turf duplicate. Preserve normal brush collision and swing cadence.

Sources: [catalog emitUnits](https://github.com/rhgrive3/actions/blob/144923aefc282a588225ac44de3da95762653add/patches/splatoon3/runtime/main-weapon-catalog.mjs#L780) · [brush source fields documentation](https://wikiwiki.jp/splatoon3mix/検証/パラメータ情報) · [Leanny pinned weapon table](https://github.com/Leanny/splat3/tree/7280ff9cde8bb1c5dcef46c700c326471584d2e6/data/parameter/1130/weapon).
**Confidence: explicit used field omission, exact native swing-side phase/palette requires capture.**

issues.title: [INKWAVE][Slosher] Four added Sloshers omit sourced NearestParam release turf
issues.body:
## Confirmed source field omission
The 11.3.0 `NearestParam.DrawSizeCollisionPaintParam` specifies paint-only near-foot splash for all added Sloshers, in addition to each unit's projectile and splash:
- Tri-Slosher (ヒッセン) **width 1.296, depth 2.0**
- Sloshing Machine (スクリュースロッシャー) **width 1.0, depth 2.0**
- Explosher (エクスプロッシャー) **width 1.56, depth 1.4**
- Dread Wringer (モップリン) **width 2.0, depth 1.2**
All have zero player collision in NearestParam. They are different from the legacy Slosher's `paintSlosherNearest` and Bloblobber's now-installed release splash (#1785).

In current catalog `emitUnits(key='slosh')`, `paintSlosherNearest` is called **only** when `sourceActor==='WeaponSlosherBathtub'`. The 4 additional weapons' sources are never read. Their real near-ground release turf therefore differs from the extracted S3 ownership.

## Acceptance
Reuse shared native grounded-authoritative `paintSlosherNearest` with each actor's exact width and depth; ensure paint once per admitted swing, no accidental actor collision, no duplicate in-flight or impact paint, no remote authority leak, and 30/60/120Hz deterministic timing. Avoid random new foot-paint multipliers.

Refs: [current source](https://github.com/rhgrive3/actions/blob/144923aefc282a588225ac44de3da95762653add/patches/splatoon3/runtime/main-weapon-catalog.mjs#L850) · [NearestParam semantics](https://wikiwiki.jp/splatoon3mix/検証/パラメータ情報) · legacy issue #978 (closed) vs separate added catalog.
**Confidence: high source-to-runtime omission.**

issues.title: [INKWAVE][Roller] Added horizontal flicks ignore separate inner/outer damage profiles
issues.body:
## Source-confirmed disparity, separate from closed legacy #58/#734
The Ver.11.3.0 `WideSwingUnitGroupParam.DamageParam` has separate `Inside` and `Outside` profiles, with a `Degree` cutoff. In **Dynamo Roller** horizontal flick, `DamageMaxValue` is **1800 inside vs 1200 outside**; in **Flingza Roller** it is **1500 inside vs 1000 outside**. Their angle regions differ (Dynamo inside 14.5°, Flingza 15°). This affects 4 added Rollers (Carbon, Dynamo, Flingza, Big Swig), with numeric damage differences strongest on Dynamo/Flingza.
The active catalog `impactDamage()` unconditionally evaluates `damage.Inside` and never branches on `damage.Outside` or the source inside/outside hit angle. A sideways hit can receive the inner damage curve despite a source-defined outer attack.

## Acceptance
Resolve the hit angle relative to the actual attack origin & camera yaw (not a generic globally-forward approximation), compose the correct source Inside/Outside distance bands, independent age rejection (#1806), low-ink depletion (#1807), and paint-only Flingza (#1804). Test direct hits at 0, boundary±epsilon, 15/20/30°, and near/far ranges under 30/60/120Hz. Historical native Splat Roller fixes #58 and #734 do not cover this catalog owner.

Sources: [catalog impactDamage()](https://github.com/rhgrive3/actions/blob/144923aefc282a588225ac44de3da95762653add/patches/splatoon3/runtime/main-weapon-catalog.mjs#L980) · [S3 roller parameter guide](https://wikiwiki.jp/splatoon3mix/検証/パラメータ情報) · [11.3.0 table](https://github.com/Leanny/splat3/tree/7280ff9cde8bb1c5dcef46c700c326471584d2e6/data/parameter/1130/weapon).
**Confidence high:** defaulting unconditionally to `Inside` contradicts the explicit source regions; exact original hit-angle formula needs confirmation.

issues.title: [INKWAVE][Slosher] Tri-Slosher/Dread Wringer miss random yaw and view-sweep source fields
issues.body:
## Source-backed nonzero fields absent in catalog emission
Both **Tri-Slosher (ヒッセン)** and **Dread Wringer (モップリン)** have explicit per-unit `RandomRotateYDegree`, `RandomRotateYBias` and `RandomRotateYOffOrderNum`:
- Tri-Slosher: **3°**, bias **0.5**, exempt index0 in group0.
- Dread Wringer: **4.5°**, bias **0.65**, exempt index0 in both groups.
Added catalog `emitUnits` reads `SpawnWideDegree`/BaseRotateYDegree only and never reads `RandomRotateYDegree/Bias/OffOrderNum`. Its first-group multiple globs align at identical headings without the source's intended yaw variation. Existing native Slosher function `slosherYawOffset()` in `weapons-fidelity.mjs` handles these fields (with its own explicitly unverified bias distribution), but the added catalog does not use it.

Separate moving-aim source mismatch: Tri-Slosher `WeaponParam.FrameOffsetMaxDegree=1.5°`, `FrameOffsetMaxMoveLength=.5`; Dread `FrameOffsetDegreeRate=1`, `FrameOffsetMaxDegree=4.5°`. `bloblobberSweepOffset` is applied only to Bloblobber; neither Tri nor Dread samples its accepted windup yaw, despite those nonzero spread thresholds.

## Acceptance
Validate reproducible index-exempt vs randomized projectiles, seeded RNG determinism and matching source yaw ranges (not necessarily a verified distribution), actual moving-camera 60Hz emission before/during windup, per-unit delayed birth and network replay. Match source angle caps and avoid treating `FrameOffsetMaxMoveLength` as proved without decoded formula. No unwanted RNG consumption for exempt indices.

Refs: [main catalog emission](https://github.com/rhgrive3/actions/blob/144923aefc282a588225ac44de3da95762653add/patches/splatoon3/runtime/main-weapon-catalog.mjs#L801), [native Slosher yaw helper](https://github.com/rhgrive3/actions/blob/144923aefc282a588225ac44de3da95762653add/patches/splatoon3/runtime/weapons-fidelity.mjs#L1007), [S3 parameter guide](https://wikiwiki.jp/splatoon3mix/検証/パラメータ情報).
**Confidence:** explicit native/pinned field omission confirmed; distribution and sweep frame law not retail-certified.

issues.title: [INKWAVE][Aim] Added Rollers and Brushes still use reticle-muzzle convergence at steep pitch
issues.body:
## 2026-10-22 診断受入完了

PR #1819の既存aimDir修正に対し、本issueが要求する「diagnostic, not guessed fix」と最新commentのstage-level camera/muzzle・obstruction・aimReadyを検証しました。原作全parityという別条件を追加せず、実装根拠と検証範囲を固定しています。

- 実Actor/WeaponRunner/Projectilesの330 true-birth・22 coverに加え、native Splat Roller両modeを含む13 mode×5仰角（-70/-45/0/+40/+70）×open/実OBB×stale/close-ground×30/60/120Hzの780 actual-flight条件を完走。全source unitのheading/velocityと実接触・source expiryを確認し、旧selectorへ戻した対照も検出しました。
- 公開Tidewaterの実Level/Physics・source-loaded Character/Actor・実FX/WebGLで追加7武器＋native対照の78条件を完走。全unit、Roller両mode、Brush両stroke、source ready/active、accepted aimとworld muzzle/FX、pre/post aimReadyを記録しました。stage描画は-45° stale-reticle sliceで、5仰角の780条件は別のactual-flight fixtureです。
- 独立weapon-only source `931e4c4a`（公開同tree `8783eb8`）/ content `d3d77b98076f1f1ca251c9c6968e1339bc648de1239720883e71204ec39bd718` 自身でも78条件を再実行し全成功。compiled production-positive5/5（skip0）、全1362input・2016artifactも照合しました。公開evidence commitの全treeもGit fetchで一致しています。

[原文ごとの受入表](https://github.com/rhgrive3/actions/blob/fcbbbbe9f529afb4bef2ac565d6c49c8f75a308e/reports/issue-resolution-20261022/continuation/issue-1812-acceptance.md)、[固定source/build・最終受入](https://github.com/rhgrive3/actions/blob/fcbbbbe9f529afb4bef2ac565d6c49c8f75a308e/reports/issue-resolution-20261022/continuation/weapon-only-final-acceptance.json)、[rawとhash](https://github.com/rhgrive3/actions/blob/fcbbbbe9f529afb4bef2ac565d6c49c8f75a308e/reports/issue-resolution-20261022/continuation/weapon-only-raw-hashes.json)。全simulation/cadence syncは維持し、WebGL drawは初期/first/steady/finalの診断frameに限定しています。software WebGLの診断であり、性能やNintendo同時実機の一致は主張しません。既存修正の残る診断条件を満たしたため閉じます。

<details>
<summary>元のissue本文（保全）</summary>

## Architectural mismatch and reproduction risk
Following Explosher fix #1794, added Sloshers use the player's accepted `aimDir` to preserve downward/upward view pitch. The 4 added Rollers (Carbon, Dynamo, Flingza, Big Swig) and 3 Brushes (Inkbrush, Octobrush, Painbrush) still enter `emitUnits` through `origin()`, which calculates `dir` via generic `Projectiles._aimFrom(actor,muzzle,dir)`, i.e. the vector from the muzzle to a possibly stale/nearby world `aimPoint`. Only the `key==='slosh'` branch is overridden with `aimDir`. The native Splat Roller source-guided `fidelityRollerLaunch` path explicitly uses camera `actor.aimPitch`, not stale aim-point convergence.
Thus the same class of *actual camera -45° but nearly horizontal output* is still possible on these 7 added weapons. This is a confirmed **different code path**, but whether a user-visible failure occurs on each stage must be tested.

## Acceptance (diagnostic, not guessed fix)
Use actual Actor/WeaponRunner/Projectiles on each weapon (vertical/horizontal Roller and both Brush swing hands). Record accepted aimPitch/aimDir, stale vs close-ground aimPoint, world muzzle/FX, all per-unit 11.3.0 heading offsets, true-birth velocity and impact at -70/-45/0/+40/+70°. Contrast native Splat Roller launch. Test cover/wall fallback, 30/60/120Hz, and existing collision. Replace reticle-convergence only where source/fixture proves wrong. 
Refs: [catalog origin+emitUnits](https://github.com/rhgrive3/actions/blob/144923aefc282a588225ac44de3da95762653add/patches/splatoon3/runtime/main-weapon-catalog.mjs#L435) · [native Roller fidelity](https://github.com/rhgrive3/actions/blob/144923aefc282a588225ac44de3da95762653add/patches/splatoon3/runtime/weapons-fidelity.mjs#L1348) · [Explosher fix #1794](https://github.com/rhgrive3/actions/pull/1794). 
**Confidence:** source-to-code architectural gap **confirmed**; per-weapon retail mismatch remains **reproduction-required**.
</details>

issues.title: [INKWAVE][Dynamo] Horizontal secondary unit has source UnitDamageRate=0 but catalog ignores it
issues.body:
## Specific sourced behavior requiring a runtime hit probe
Pinned S3 11.3.0 `WeaponRollerHeavy` Dynamo horizontal `WideSwingUnitGroupParam.Unit[1]` has `BulletNum=2` and the explicit property **`UnitDamageRate = 0`**. Its group-0 ink particles have no such override. The installed catalog `emitUnits()` assigns both unit groups the shared `WideSwingUnitGroupParam.DamageParam`, while `impactDamage()` reads only the group damage distance bands and never reads `UnitDamageRate`. Thus the zero rate is ignored and the two secondary pellets may receive group-level player damage.

**Do not assume the extracted 0 proves complete harmlessness** until confirming Nintendo's exact semantics. It could be a source-specific multiplier or sentinel; the S3 community parameter page does not explicitly document this field. Confirm with a target placed in the path of unit1 without central-unit overlap.

## Acceptance
Use a production-composed Dynamo horizontal flick with fixed RNG and source unit indexes to isolate unit1. Compare actual damage, object hit, collision/ink, native Splat Roller cross-check and captured S3 11.3.0. If `0` suppresses player damage in retail, fix its selective hit admissibility without erasing source turf particles or crossfire. Coordinate with #1810 (inside/outside damage) and #1804 (Flingza PaintOnly).

Refs: https://github.com/Leanny/splat3/blob/7280ff9cde8bb1c5dcef46c700c326471584d2e6/data/parameter/1130/weapon/WeaponRollerHeavy.game__GameParameterTable.json ; https://github.com/rhgrive3/actions/blob/144923aefc282a588225ac44de3da95762653add/patches/splatoon3/runtime/main-weapon-catalog.mjs#L780.
**Evidence: high source-field omission; player-damage semantics unverified.**

issues.title: [INKWAVE] S3 11.3.0 65-main-weapon behavioral parity audit and 10-gap remediation tracker
issues.body:
# Splatoon 3 Ver.11.3.0 main-weapon source/behavior gap inventory
2026-10-22 main source baseline `144923aefc282a588225ac44de3da95762653add`. Target is production-composed `inkwave-public` + `patches/splatoon3`, not an obsolete standalone `src` tree.

## Scope
Extracted catalog contains **65 main-weapon base rows**, of which **7 are legacy/native owners** and **58 are added catalog implementations**, across 11 families (Shooter14, Blaster7, Roller5, Brush3, Charger8, Slosher6, Splatling6, Dualies6, Brella4, Stringer3, Splatana3). Variants/cosmetic kits sharing behavior are not 65 additional independent physics records.

A structural audit of all 65 source rows and the installed runtime found **10 individually tracked gaps affecting at least 11 distinct added weapons** in Roller, Brush, and Slosher families. This is *not* a certification that the other 54 already match retail gameplay: some features are implemented in other imported modules and a full frame-by-frame retail baseline has not been recovered.

## Source-to-code omissions, prioritized
| Ticket | Affected | Observation | Confidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| #1804 | Flingza | 12 paint-only side globs not excluded from damage | source flag omitted |
| #1805 | Carbon/Dynamo/Flingza/Big Swig | per-index pitch and yaw-source offset omitted | source field omitted |
| #1806 | 4 added Rollers + 3 Brushes | DamageRejectStart/EndFrame/Rate time falloff omitted | source field omitted |
| #1807 | 4 Rollers + 3 Brushes | no low-ink DepletionBulletNum/SpeedRate branch | source field omitted |
| #1808 | Inkbrush/Octobrush/Painbrush | L→R/R→L yaw offsets and near-foot paint slots skipped | source field omitted |
| #1809 | Tri/Launcher/Explosher/Dread | NearestParam release turf omitted (Blob fixed) | source field omitted |
| #1810 | 4 Rollers | outside vs inside damage profiles ignored | source field omitted |
| #1811 | Tri-Slosher & Dread Wringer | RandomRotateY* and FrameOffsetMaxDegree sweep omitted | source field omitted |
| #1812 | 4 Rollers + 3 Brushes | reticle world-point convergence may flatten steep camera pitch; contrast native aimPitch owner | proven architectural mismatch, runtime/retail reproduction pending |
| #1813 | Dynamo | extra horizontal unit has UnitDamageRate=0 ignored | source omission, native meaning pending |

## Existing related issues
- #1431 Explosher/Quad physical-vs-displayed muzzle/FX origin alignment (~568mm early/Explosher).
- #1789 Bloblobber exact Nintendo slope/ground rebound and `BounceAfterMaxSpeed` semantics.
- Already merged #1794 fixed catalog Slosher down-45° camera pitch and XZ-source lift; do not duplicate.
- Closed legacy-only Roller fixes #58, #124, #128, #305, #734 do not establish that a separate **added** catalog owner inherits them.

## Validation plan
For the affected 11 weapons, run real Actor→WeaponRunner→Projectile tests at ±45°, moving aim, full/low ink, 30/60/120Hz, terrain, hit/no-hit thresholds and replicated ghost packets. Use pinned source numbers as assertions; compare matching hardware recordings before claiming exact Nintendo behavior. Maintain zero gameplay changes in this audit itself and separate fixes by physical ownership/damage/net protocol.

Sources: [Leanny pinned 11.3.0 tables](https://github.com/Leanny/splat3/tree/7280ff9cde8bb1c5dcef46c700c326471584d2e6/data/parameter/1130/weapon) · [Japanese detailed parameter guide](https://wikiwiki.jp/splatoon3mix/検証/パラメータ情報) · [catalog interpreter](https://github.com/rhgrive3/actions/blob/144923aefc282a588225ac44de3da95762653add/patches/splatoon3/runtime/main-weapon-catalog.mjs).


### 2026-10-22 continuation: catalogue admission and combined preview

#1846 prevents catalogue sub/special metadata from applying after native clock/header/session rejection. The new tests plus emitted integration pass 20/20. A separate isolated Node 22 production build combines the clock, catalogue and weapon changes: compiled 25/25 pass, 0 fail/skip, with all 1,364 Git inputs and 2,018 artifacts verified. [Frozen compatibility evidence](https://github.com/rhgrive3/actions/blob/5ca8eac0903f96985dbd43109ea30f5e920a8c05/reports/issue-resolution-20261022/continuation/combined-runtime-review.md) preserves both behavior-report chapters and all nine runtime leaf hashes. This is a diagnostic branch (DO NOT MERGE), not a replacement for the four source PRs or a browser/physical-device/parity acceptance.

The evidence also preserves a bounded Brella presentation-sidecar finding: an accepted 129-row packet bypasses the optional reader's 128-row cap, then a stale one-row replay can add presentation metadata to the existing accepted snapshot. Actual rendering and gameplay impact have not been demonstrated; it is outside the catalogue kit fix, and no claim that all wrappers are safe is made. Full 65-main authority/parity work remains open.

1812.body: PR #1819 connected the admitted camera aimDir to the added Roller/Brush launcher, removing the code-level reticle/muzzle convergence mismatch and adding ±45° real-emitter tests. This ticket stays OPEN until the queued tests and stage-level camera/muzzle comparison verify the 7 weapons, including obstruction and aimReady.

1813.body: PR #1818 now treats Dynamo WideSwing Unit[1] explicit UnitDamageRate=0 as a zero-authority source unit. This avoids full-power phantom hits, and pure unit tests cover it. The original Nintendo engine meaning of UnitDamageRate=0 is still not independently decoded and game A/B has not completed. Keep this issue OPEN for retail confirmation.

1814.body: 監査レポートを [PR #1816](https://github.com/rhgrive3/actions/pull/1816) に作成しました。Ver.11.3.0の全65ベースレコード（7 native + 58 catalog）を武器別台帳化し、ソース欄が実装に接続されていない問題を #1804〜#1813 の10件に分離しています（確定欠落8種、実射確認が要る照準経路1種、意味が未確定の数値1種）。対象は少なくともローラー4、フデ3、スロッシャー4の計11種です。2024年の弾道研究PDFについても11.3.0の実測ではない部分を区別して記載しました。レポートだけではIssue解決ではないため、ここはOpenのまま継続して検証と改修の起点にします。

The tracking Issue auto-closed because PR #1816's description included a negative instruction referencing a closing keyword. Reopening: main code fixes #1818/#1819/#1822 are merged but all 10 source gaps are not *retail-certified*. CI and Pages for latest main are queued. #1812 and #1813 retain exact hardware-equality semantics; source-parity issue status does not replace tests.

2026-10-22 09:19 UTC 現在の継続記録。

- #1818（ダメージ・PaintOnly）、#1819（射出角・塗り）、#1822（低インク）はすべて main にsquash済み。
- 独立した Node 22 の修正後回帰実行で source-launch 6/6、depletion 4/4 の通過を確認した #1825 を Ready に変更し main に統合。main SHA `26a4db4123d23162a3dbf8a12150b1b5bc6ccf64`。
- ソース欠落の10件中、#1804〜#1811（8件）Closed。#1812（各ステージ・照準の原点実機比較）、#1813（Dynamo UnitDamageRate=0の本家ネイティブ解釈）は Open 維持。いずれも実装コード側の変更あり、任天堂側の完全一致は未認証。
- mainの Actions（numerical #39754463890, Validate #39754463804, A+ #39754463717, Pages #39754463814）は GitHub queue/pending で成功をまだ主張できない。既存の独立 Node 10/10はこれらの代用ではない。
- このIssue #1814は完了まで開いたままにする。重複した大規模PR/CIを作らず、実行されたジョブ結果で個別差異を検証する。
